referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of various components for a ventilation system for an office building with offices, common rooms, kitchen, restaurant, auditorium and car park. The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 10161 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 54400 m3/h, total weight of the components: 11810 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 5.4 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for air valves, air intake, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers and sensors.; UUID: 5f22b9a5-6d82-4f47-bab0-1125ba5f445c
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Transport to dismantling facilities, machines for handling in sorting plant, electricity demand for sorting plant, final disposal of waste material. Cut-off to recycling for metals.
